convert_tr_ocr_checkpoint: convert a TrOCR checkpoint from the unilm repository to a HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoderModel
create_rename_keys: create a list of weight key renaming mappings from DEIT encoder to HuggingFace ViT encoder structure
read_in_q_k_v: split a combined qkv weight matrix into separate query, key, and value weight tensors for each encoder layer
prepare_img: download and prepare a test image from the IAM Handwriting Database or SROIE dataset for checkpoint verification
run_convert_script: run the CLI script with --checkpoint_url and --pytorch_dump_folder_path to convert and save a TrOCR model
